## Problem and change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link any related issue.

## Validation

List checks run and their results. State anything not tested. Use synthetic data and sanitize screenshots and logs.

## Compatibility

Note migrations, configuration changes, breaking behavior, or security implications. Write “None” if not applicable.

- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Regression coverage is included where behavior changes.
- [ ] No credentials, real user data, or secret-bearing test artifacts are included.
